question.text: A light spring balance hangs from the hook of the other light spring balance and a block of mass M kg hangs from the former one. Then the true statement about the scale reading is

options.text: The scale of the lower one reads $\mathrm{M} \mathrm{kg}$ and of the upper one zero
The reading of the two scales can be anything but the sum of the reading will be $\mathrm{M} \mathrm{kg}$
